name: Semantic context
responsibility: One per tab session: turns its panes' gestures and every settled change of the boards in its panes' vaults into briefs and events
description: Each brief names its board's vault, so a thread passes it to the CLI with -C. It hears the board changes of the vaults its tab session's panes are in, and drops a cosmetic one, which is no news. Archboard's announcements tell each change only to the workhorse of the board's checkout, so a workhorse is told about the boards it works on.

outgoing.label: each settled board change, focus and selection it publishes
